merchant/30559.htm.text: Trader Kunai: For the eternal glory of the Flame! Child of the Flame, how are you? I am Kunai, a weapons trader. I guarantee that our Dwarven-made products are of the best quality. Those stinking Dwarves should be stomped back into their caves, but we can't deny that they make good weapons, eh? Ha …

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

merchant/30559-1.htm.text: Trader Kunai: What are you looking for, friend?

merchant/30559-pk.htm.text: Trader Kunai: I am very proud that I'm one of the brothers of flame, descendants of great Paagrio! I do not want to talk to you, lawbreaker, so go away from me!

Q00004_LongLiveThePaagrioLord/30559-02.h.text: Trader Kunai: Why do you still have the gift the Duda-Mara tribe prepared for the Flame Lord? Go at once and deliver the Spider Dust to Centurion Nakusin !

Q00004_LongLiveThePaagrioLord/30559-01.h.text: Trader Kunai: Other tribes may see this as an opportunity to puff out their chests and offer the Flame Lord something costly, extravagant...and utterly useless. But the Duda-Mara tribe is not vain; we simply wish for him to recover speedily from this illness that afflicts him. Accordingly, our elde…

Q00268_TracesOfEvil/30559-02.htm.text: Trader Kunai: As you know, creatures infected by the curse of the Fiend Kasha are everywhere, even just beyond the walls of our Orc Village. We cannot simply wait and watch any longer -- we must discover the source of the curse. I wish to use the vision of the Duda-Mara tribe to divine it, but the …

Q00268_TracesOfEvil/30559-01.htm.text: Trader Kunai: What do you know about the Fiend Kasha, whose very essence causes corruption and death ? I honor your valor, but this mission is too important to entrust to one so inexperienced. Devote yourself to your training, and one day perhaps you may serve our great race in something equally vi…

Q00268_TracesOfEvil/30559-04.html.text: Trader Kunai: Leave now without further delay. We do not have much time! Remember, you must collect 30 Contaminated Kasha Spider Venom samples .

Q00268_TracesOfEvil/30559-05.html.text: Trader Kunai: I am disappointed by your lack of effort! You have not obtained nearly the number of samples I require for this vital task. For the medium to function properly, we need more...and time is running out! Hurry and bring me 30 Contaminated Kasha Spider Venom samples .

Q00268_TracesOfEvil/30559-06.html.text: Trader Kunai: Ah, you have returned safely! On behalf of the Duda-Mara tribe, I thank you. Now, Pa'agrio willing, I will finally discover the source of this curse. I do not know where this path will lead, but you have made it possible for us to follow it. Here is the reward I promised you. Take it,…

Q00268_TracesOfEvil/30559-03.htm.text: Trader Kunai: On behalf of the Duda-Mara tribe, I thank you! There is much to do... In order to discover the source of this curse, we require a medium. Once the Kasha Spider was our sacred symbol, and even though it has been corrupted by this fiend, it will still be suitable for our purposes. Go to…
